Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Bye, bye fools! See ya!
Landlord: Damn it! 
Landlord: And why are you still standing there?! Go back to your apartment before I kick you out!
You: W-What about my rent?
Landlord: Rrrgh! 
Landlord: I can’t go back on my word, or this shyster’s gonna sue me to oblivion…
You: So that means…
Landlord: {{punch}}THAT MEANS THAT IF YOU WON’T GO BACK TO YOUR APARTMENT I’M GONNA MAKE AN EXAMPLE OUT OF YOU SO THAT NO OTHER TENANT WILL EVER GET THE IDEA TO WEAPONIZE THAT LAWYER AGAINST ME!
